title: Motorcycle Seat Cover Camo – Ventilated Protection
descriptionHtml:
A cool place to sit and a protected seat

A motorcycle seat gets both hot and worn from sun and use. On warm days the seat can become uncomfortable to sit on.

Ventilated cover in camo

This seat cover vents away heat and protects the seat from wear. It goes on easily with an elastic edge and gives a stylish camo look.

Features

  • Vents away heat
  • Protects the seat from wear
  • Elastic edge for easy fitting
  • Stylish camo design
  • Hard-wearing polyester material

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
